operation.name: GetBeneficiariesDIS
operation.query:
select distinct B.intBenID ,B.EnrollmentNo ,B.NameofHousehold ,B.Sex ,B.Age ,B.SelectionCriteria ,B.ContactNo ,B.Email ,B.FamilyIncome ,B.intStateID ,s.StateName ,B.intCountieID ,c.CountieName ,B.intPayamID ,p.PayamName ,B.intBomasID ,bo.BomaName
from tbl_BeneficiaryDet as B inner join tm_States as s on s.intStateid = b.intStateid inner join tm_Counties as c on c.intCountieid = b.intCountieid inner join tm_Payams as P on p.intPayamid = b.intPayamid inner join tm_Bomas as BO on bo.intBomasid = b.intBomasid inner join p2_beneficiary ben on b.household_number = ben.household_number where intbenid not in( select a.intbenid from td_WageReqBenDet a inner join td_WorkWageRequest c on c.intWagePaymentReqid= a.intWagePaymentReqid where a.intworkid=999 and c.ReqYear=@Year and c.ReqMonth=@Month ) and intbenid not in ( select a.intbenid from td_WageReqBenDet a inner join td_WorkWageRequest c on c.intWagePaymentReqid= a.intWagePaymentReqid where a.intworkid=999 and c.PaymentCycle = @PaymentCycle ) and B.SelectionCriteria = 'Component 1 (Direct Income Support)' and ben.registration_phase = 0
